note: `charset_dispatch.forwarded_glyph_limit` is a semantic view over the vulnerable dispatch call expression `u.format1.get_glyph (sid)`: the instrumentation records `0` there because the vulnerable format-1 branch forwards no glyph-count argument at all, while the fixed branch records the real second argument `num_glyphs`. `range_compare.glyph_limit` re-exposes that same vulnerable-source `num_glyphs` at the format-1 compare site via trace-only carry state because the vulnerable `Charset1_2::get_glyph` signature drops the formal before the sink.
